create_error_response: create an Anthropic-formatted error response dict from a status code and message
transform_to_anthropic_error: transform a raw error message into Anthropic error format with status code and optional request id
extract_error_message: extract an error message from Bedrock, AWS, generic JSON, or plain text response
get_error_type: map an HTTP status code to an Anthropic error type string
test_is_anthropic_error_dict: test whether a parsed dict conforms to the Anthropic error format structure
